text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That's the gist of it. So will you be<n>coming to my
birthday party, Brian? ♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I don't have to go. Is there any<n>reason why I
should?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
A reason? Well... can't you come<n>just because
someone special wants<n>you to?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'm your rival. That makes me a<n>special person,
pretty much the same<n>as a friend. ♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I don't want to go. I'm not<n>interested in
sweet stuff like cake.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh, didn't I mention? We're all going<n>to an
all-you-can-eat barbecue for my<n>birthday.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's this place I've been going to for<n>all sorts of
celebrations since my<n>days in the Victory Club. ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
And they have a good price even<n>though their
charcoal grills are the real<n>deal! And when you taste
their<n>specially made sauce...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you want to go now, right? Hehe.<n>♪ I'll teach
you the best way to grill<n>too!
